essence: Joined hands and a one-footed stance are permitted postural options.
Separate placement and shared seating are both valid arrangements.
Brahma and Viṣṇu are regarded as suitable figures for the left side.
The triad may be represented as united within a shared abode.
Separate or shared enclosures are both acceptable configurations.
